title: 第25章 争执第26章 晋级
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
唐三背着她，时不时应和两声，宁苒苒一笑，唐三也跟着勾了勾唇角。
见唐三的心情好了起来，宁苒苒讲得也更加起劲了。
这个傻姑娘哪里知道，唐三是见她说的开心，所以也忍不住高兴。
他心里隐秘的想，知道了小姑娘的童年，他是不是也算的上是参与了呢？
夜色下，少年稳稳的背着背上的小姑娘，一步一步的走在道路上。
这场景，一如六岁那年，两人初见的那天夜晚。
这一瞬间，一个六岁和一个十二岁少年的身影在某一刻重叠了。
……分割线……
眼看着快到学院门口了，宁苒苒发现前面正在发生争吵。
“戴沐白！
竹清已经说了，让你放开！”
是宁荣荣的声音。
“这是我和竹清的事情，你凭什么管？”
戴沐白拽住朱竹清的手腕，朝着宁荣荣十分强硬。
脸上那凶煞的表情有些吓到了宁荣荣。
宁苒苒赶紧示意唐三将她放下，然后三步作两步的走向宁荣荣。
她想起来了，原着里，戴沐白和宁荣荣在学院门口曾发生过争执。
只是当时是宁荣荣去言语挑衅的戴沐白，也是她当时口无遮拦令戴沐白起了恼意，差点要打杀了宁荣荣，幸好被奥斯卡护着，这才没有受重伤。
只是，这次因为宁苒苒的出现，宁荣荣的脾气已经不再像原着里的小魔女了，怎么还会……
“怎么了怎么了？姐，发生什么事情了？”

宁苒苒挡在宁荣荣身前：“你们怎么突然吵起来了？”
宁荣荣见到来人，难看的脸色总算舒缓了些，她说：“我回来的时候，戴沐白和竹清正在门口发生争执，竹清已经很明确表示不想跟他谈了，谁知道戴沐白直接动手拽住她。
我一看竹清可是我们朋友，要是我没看到还好，既然被我看到了，他可别想当着我的面再欺负竹清一个女孩子。”
朱竹清听到宁荣荣的话，眼里闪过一抹柔软与感激。
她转头看向戴沐白，冷冷的说：“放手！”
戴沐白下意识的松手，宁荣荣眼疾手快的将朱竹清拉到身后，宁苒苒脸上严肃：“戴大哥，如果你想和竹清好好谈谈，那你不该是这种态度，虽然我不知道你们发生了什么，但是竹清的样子很明显非常排斥你。”
“你这样强硬，换成任何一个人都不会好好听你讲的。
我这不是想偏心竹清，而是想告诉你，如果你想和竹清好好谈谈，就应该拿出你的诚意来，而不是胡搅蛮缠！”
宁荣荣点头，语气依然不太好：“就是，你这样，别说是竹清了，任何一个女孩子都不可能会喜欢，更别说有好脸色。”
戴沐白怔怔的看着朱竹清，嘴唇嗫嚅了一下，发现自己不知道该说什么。
“竹清，我们走！”
朱竹清听话的被宁荣荣拉着走了。
宁荣荣转头：“苒苒，走不走？”
content_en:
Tang San carried her on his back and responded occasionally. Ning Ranran smiled, and Tang San also curled his lips.
Seeing that Tang San's mood improved, Ning Ranran also spoke more energetically.
How did this silly girl know that Tang San was happy to see her talking, so he couldn't help but be happy.
He secretly wondered in his heart, if he knew about the little girl's childhood, could he be considered involved?
Under the night, the boy held the little girl on his back steadily and walked on the road step by step.
This scene is just like the night when the two first met when they were six years old.
At this moment, the figures of a six-year-old boy and a twelve-year-old boy overlapped at a certain moment.
...dividing line...
Seeing that they were approaching the entrance of the college, Ning Ranran noticed that there was a quarrel in front of them.
"Dai Mubai!
Zhuqing has already told you to let go! "
It was Ning Rongrong's voice.
"This is a matter between me and Zhuqing, why do you care?"
Dai Mubai grabbed Zhu Zhuqing's wrist and faced Ning Rongrong very forcefully.
The fierce expression on his face frightened Ning Rongrong.
Ning Ranran quickly signaled Tang San to put her down, and then walked towards Ning Rongrong in two steps.
She remembered that in the original novel, Dai Mubai and Ning Rongrong had a dispute at the entrance of the college.
It was just that Ning Rongrong was the one who provoked Dai Mubai with her words, and it was her unobtrusive words that made Dai Mubai angry, and he almost killed Ning Rongrong. Fortunately, Oscar protected him and he was not seriously injured.
However, this time because of Ning Ranran's appearance, Ning Rongrong's temper is no longer like the little witch in the original work. How could she still...
"What's wrong? Sister, what happened?"
Ning Ranran stood in front of Ning Rongrong: "Why did you suddenly start a fight?"
When Ning Rongrong saw the visitor, her ugly face finally softened, and she said, "When I came back, Dai Mubai and Zhu Qing were arguing at the door. Zhu Qing had already made it clear that she didn't want to talk to him, but Dai Mubai directly grabbed her.
When I saw that Zhuqing was our friend, it would have been better if I hadn't seen it. Now that I had seen it, he wouldn't even think of bullying Zhuqing, a girl, in front of me. "
When Zhu Zhuqing heard Ning Rongrong's words, a touch of softness and gratitude flashed in his eyes.
She turned to look at Dai Mubai and said coldly: "Let go!"
Dai Mubai subconsciously let go, and Ning Rongrong quickly pulled Zhu Zhuqing behind him. Ning Ranran's face was serious: "Brother Dai, if you want to have a good talk with Zhu Qing, then you shouldn't have this attitude. Although I don't know what happened between you, Zhu Qing's appearance clearly rejects you."
"If you are so tough, no one would listen to what you have to say.
I don’t want to favor Zhuqing, but I want to tell you that if you want to have a good talk with Zhuqing, you should show your sincerity instead of messing around! "
Ning Rongrong nodded, but her tone was still not good: "That's right, if you are like this, no girl, let alone Zhu Qing, will like you, let alone have a good face."
Dai Mubai looked at Zhu Zhuqing blankly, twitching his lips and realizing that he didn't know what to say.
"Zhuqing, let's go!"
Zhu Zhuqing was pulled away by Ning Rongrong obediently.
Ning Rongrong turned around: "Ran Ran, are you leaving?"
